blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Monday said 234 school counselor associates were hired in Pangasinan to strengthen mental health and counseling services in public schools. He made the announcement during the mass oath-taking ceremony for newly promoted and newly hired Department of Education (DepEd) personnel in the province. READ: DepEd: Over 172,000 teachers, staff to get Apple laptops “Today, we are gathered here; we have witnessed the oath-taking of over 5,211 newly promoted personnel and school heads, as well as 234 newly hired school counselor associates in Pangasinan,” he said in his speech at the CSI Stadia in Dagupan City. “We also […]...
